verdicts.note: Prompt gives general categories (breakage, cost, compliance) but doesn't name specific issues, number of problems, or review methods. Mention of past duplicate incidents is reasonable context.
Clear: review docs/design/notification-fanout.md and supporting docs, write to REVIEW.md, output as fenced JSON with section, severity, issue, fix.
Several items require cross-file analysis (capacity vs traffic CSV, rate limits vs vendor limits, encryption requirement vs design). Quick review wouldn't find all items.

All 7 key items have evidence in fixture: deduplication (5.3 no duplicate detection), retry (5.3 indefinite, no DLQ), capacity (5.5 10k vs traffic 550), throttling (5.4.2 100/sec limit no throttling), PII (5.7.1 not encrypted vs service-targets encryption required), zone (5.6 single AZ for 99.95%), timezone (5.8 fixed US/Eastern). All severities reasonable.
File names are appropriate supporting docs (incident report, vendor limits, traffic data). No inline hints or comments in design document pointing at problems.
